python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
items = [json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
start = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][1])
n = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][2]) if len(['zoom/batch.py', '0']) > 2 else 5
rows = []
for i, it in enumerate(items[start:start + n], start):
    w = Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB')
    l = Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
    row = Image.new('RGB', (max(1400, w.width, l.width), w.height + l.height + 40), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(row)
    d.text((4, 3), str(i + 1) + ' ' + it['item_id'], fill='black')
    row.paste(w, (0, 25))
    row.paste(l, (0, w.height + 30))
    rows.append(row)
out = Image.new('RGB', (max((r.width for r in rows)), sum((r.height for r in rows))), 'white')
y = 0
for r in rows:
    out.paste(r, (0, y))
    y += r.height
out.save('zoom/batch.png')
print('total', len(items), 'batch', start + 1, start + len(rows))

n = int(['zoom/batch.py', '20'][2]) if len(['zoom/batch.py', '20']) > 2 else 5
rows = []
for i, it in enumerate(items[start:start + n], start):
    w = Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB')
    l = Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
    row = Image.new('RGB', (max(1400, w.width, l.width), w.height + l.height + 40), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(row)
    d.text((4, 3), str(i + 1) + ' ' + it['item_id'], fill='black')
    row.paste(w, (0, 25))
    row.paste(l, (0, w.height + 30))
    rows.append(row)
out = Image.new('RGB', (max((r.width for r in rows)), sum((r.height for r in rows))), 'white')
y = 0
for r in rows:
    out.paste(r, (0, y))
    y += r.height
out.save('zoom/batch.png')
print('total', len(items), 'batch', start + 1, start + len(rows))

import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
items = [json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
start = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][1])
n = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][2]) if len(['zoom/batch.py', '0']) > 2 else 5
rows = []
for i, it in enumerate(items[start:start + n], start):
    w = Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB')
    l = Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
    row = Image.new('RGB', (max(1400, w.width, l.width), w.height + l.height + 40), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(row)
    d.text((4, 3), str(i + 1) + ' ' + it['item_id'], fill='black')
    row.paste(w, (0, 25))
    row.paste(l, (0, w.height + 30))
    rows.append(row)
out = Image.new('RGB', (max((r.width for r in rows)), sum((r.height for r in rows))), 'white')
y = 0
for r in rows:
    out.paste(r, (0, y))
    y += r.height
out.save('zoom/batch.png')
print('total', len(items), 'batch', start + 1, start + len(rows))

items = [json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
start = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][1])
n = int(['zoom/batch.py', '0'][2]) if len(['zoom/batch.py', '0']) > 2 else 5
rows = []
for i, it in enumerate(items[start:start + n], start):
    w = Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB')
    l = Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
    row = Image.new('RGB', (max(1400, w.width, l.width), w.height + l.height + 40), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(row)
    d.text((4, 3), str(i + 1) + ' ' + it['item_id'], fill='black')
    row.paste(w, (0, 25))
    row.paste(l, (0, w.height + 30))
    rows.append(row)
out = Image.new('RGB', (max((r.width for r in rows)), sum((r.height for r in rows))), 'white')
y = 0
for r in rows:
    out.paste(r, (0, y))
    y += r.height
out.save('zoom/batch.png')
print('total', len(items), 'batch', start + 1, start + len(rows))

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
items = [json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
start = int(['zoom/batch.py', '30'][1])
n = int(['zoom/batch.py', '30'][2]) if len(['zoom/batch.py', '30']) > 2 else 5
rows = []
for i, it in enumerate(items[start:start + n], start):
    w = Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB')
    l = Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
    row = Image.new('RGB', (max(1400, w.width, l.width), w.height + l.height + 40), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(row)
    d.text((4, 3), str(i + 1) + ' ' + it['item_id'], fill='black')
    row.paste(w, (0, 25))
    row.paste(l, (0, w.height + 30))
    rows.append(row)
out = Image.new('RGB', (max((r.width for r in rows)), sum((r.height for r in rows))), 'white')
y = 0
for r in rows:
    out.paste(r, (0, y))
    y += r.height
out.save('zoom/batch.png')
print('total', len(items), 'batch', start + 1, start + len(rows))
